# Agent plans API

Inspect saved plans and their steps.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_plan` | [List agent plans](#op-get-v1-agent-plan) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_plan/{id}` | [Get agent plan](#op-get-v1-agent-plan-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_plan_step` | [List agent plan steps](#op-get-v1-agent-plan-step) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_plan_step/{id}` | [Get agent plan step](#op-get-v1-agent-plan-step-id) |

## List agent plans {#op-get-v1-agent-plan}

`GET /v1/agent_plan`

Returns a paginated list of AgentPlan

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_plan" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of AgentPlan

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].agent_plan_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_run_id` | string |  |
| `data[].agent_session_id` | string |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].metadata` | object |  |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: pending, running, blocked, complete, failed, cancelled. |
| `data[].summary` | object |  |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].title` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workspace_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "agent_plan_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "agent_run_id": "",
      "agent_session_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "metadata": {},
      "status": "pending",
      "summary": "",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "title": "Agent plan",
      "updated_at": 1791072000,
      "workspace_id": ""
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```


## Get agent plan {#op-get-v1-agent-plan-id}

`GET /v1/agent_plan/{id}`

Returns a single AgentPlan

Set `agent_plan_id` using IDs from your own API responses.

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | Resource identifier from your team's API results. |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_plan/${ADIOS_AGENT_PLAN_ID}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```

AgentPlan
